subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept operation-aware sender selection and QQBot immediate reconnect replay as the permanent delivery contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, proven, and has no actionable defect, but shared plugin winner selection and reconnect retry timing are compatibility-sensitive behavior choices that require owner intent.

options.title: Accept And Merge
options.body: Rebase, rerun exact-head checks, and land because the resolver and replay behavior follow existing delivery-handler and queue contracts.

options.title: Narrow Immediate Replay
options.body: Retain the resolver and canonical queue drain but reduce QQBot's bypass-backoff error matching before merge.

options.title: Redesign Plugin Ownership
options.body: Pause or replace the branch if maintainers want setup/runtime overlap represented through a different shared plugin API.

recommendation.title: Accept And Merge
recommendation.body: Rebase, rerun exact-head checks, and land because the resolver and replay behavior follow existing delivery-handler and queue contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The central shared resolver and queue contract need the broadest owner decision; masatohoshino and vincentkoc are strong QQBot lifecycle reviewers for the channel-specific half.
